global_rules: Use the Thai text lock exactly through {{thai_text_lock_block}}.
Do not create chat screenshots, fake conversations, fake testimonials, or fake platform UI.
Use premium cyber-luxury advertising account visuals without implying impossible outcomes.
Leave space for human review before public publishing.

templates.title: Cyber Queen Trust Poster
templates.prompt: Create a premium dark cyber-luxury poster for {{brand}}. Visual: elegant queen-inspired silhouette, neon magenta and violet rim light, secure ad-account dashboard motifs, no platform logos, no fake chat UI. Composition: centered headline area, high contrast, clean product proof mood. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nAudience: {{audience}}. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Account Stability Poster
templates.prompt: Create a professional Thai advertising account service poster for {{brand}}. Visual: stable control-room grid, glowing account cards, premium black-charcoal base, violet-pink accents, subtle shield iconography, no fake messages and no screenshots of real customer data. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nGoal: {{asset_goal}}. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Support 24h Poster
templates.prompt: Create a polished service-support poster for {{brand}}. Visual: night-shift operations desk, neon crown line art, reliable support aura, dark glass panels, clean CTA area, no fake review cards, no fake chat UI. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nMood: responsive, premium, calm. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Brand Authority Cover
templates.prompt: Design a Facebook cover image for {{brand}} with a wide cinematic layout. Visual: black-to-charcoal cyber luxury background, crown motif, ad account control panels as abstract shapes, magenta-violet glow, spacious Thai text area. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nDo not show simulated conversations, platform-confusing interface, or customer data. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Campaign Launch Cover
templates.prompt: Design a launch cover for {{brand}}. Visual: high-end digital campaign command center, queen/crown accent, luminous cards representing ad accounts, polished SaaS-like layout, dark base with pink-violet highlights. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nUse clean space for CTA and avoid exaggerated outcome claims. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: LINE OA Rich Menu Cover
templates.prompt: Design a LINE OA cover/rich-menu hero for {{brand}}. Visual: premium ad-account support hub, crown emblem, compact service tiles, dark cyber-luxury style, no fake conversation screenshot. Thai overlay text must be exactly:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nButtons may be abstract placeholders only: {{cta_labels}}. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Queen Signal Opening
templates.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical video storyboard for {{brand}}. Scene 1: dark neon crown signal appears. Scene 2: abstract ad-account cards align into a secure grid. Scene 3: final product lockup with exact Thai overlay text:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nMotion: premium, smooth, cyber-luxury. Do not show fake chat UI or real platform screens. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Stability Sequence
templates.prompt: Create a 12-second vertical video storyboard for {{brand}}. Scene 1: unstable ad chaos represented by abstract red noise, no real platform UI. Scene 2: ADS Queen control layer stabilizes glowing account cards. Scene 3: exact Thai overlay text appears:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nTone: trustworthy, premium, energetic. Format: {{format}}.

templates.title: Support Loop
templates.prompt: Create an 8-second looping short video storyboard for {{brand}}. Scene 1: neon clock and support signal. Scene 2: crown icon pulses over abstract service panels. Scene 3: CTA lockup with exact Thai overlay text:\n{{thai_text_lock_block}}\nAvoid fake chats, fake reviews, and customer data. Format: {{format}}.
